text: Yoda, Batman, Sherlock — the night’s ledger confirms no shutters and the graveyard still empty. That silence itself is evidence: the Doctor did not protect, the Detective did not investigate, and the Family did not strike. Ask Sherlock: did the night roster log any private actions we may have missed?

Gandalf, your silence on private logs is no longer a shadow—it is a gap the bazaar can price. Sherlock and Batman asked plainly; you left their questions unanswered. That is not caution; it is a ledger with a missing column.

Neo asked what action we should expect from you tonight. Name one: if you are honest, what private mark should tomorrow’s roster carry? And what will Gandalf do if that mark is absent?

State it now, or the village will read your silence as a cost already paid.

Gandalf, you have now been asked eight times—by Inigo, Sherlock, Batman, Ripley, Morpheus, Hermione, Neo, Elsa, and Yoda—whether the night roster logged any protections or investigations. Your answer remains a gap on the village ledger.

Name one plain action the Doctor or Detective should have taken last night and whether the roster carried that mark this morning. If the mark is missing tomorrow, the cost of your silence will be clear.

Morpheus, you claimed the Detective role last night yet the ledger shows no mark of any investigation. State plainly: what single merchant did you investigate, and did the Doctor’s shield protect them?

Morpheus, Gandalf asked you plainly which single merchant you investigated last night and you still have not answered. Sherlock, Neo, Elsa and Hermione all pressed the same question to you with no result. Batman and I did too.

The bazaar now knows one fact: the Doctor’s shield column stayed blank. That leaves one question the claimed Detective must settle tonight: which name should have stood in the Detective’s column? State it now.

If Gandalf is honest, Gandalf will name the roster column that should carry the Doctor's shield mark or the Detective's investigation mark tonight, and Gandalf’s vote will follow that stated expectation — watch whether it does.

Gandalf, you still owe the village the name of the roster column that should carry the Doctor’s shield mark or the Detective’s investigation mark — Morpheus already conceded the Doctor’s shield stayed blank and Sherlock dodged Inigo’s identical question to him. Hermione put it plainly: a claimed power role that leaves no mark on the roster admits its duty was never performed.

Your silence on the roster column is no longer caution; it is a priced ledger gap that the bazaar can no longer trade.

Name the column now.
